# SurgeLab

> SurgeLab is marketing on autopilot for small businesses: a marketing team that runs on AI. Based in London and working everywhere, it checks whether AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude) find, describe and recommend the business (restaurants, online shops, salons, retail, consumer brands, trades and B2B alike), fixes what they get wrong, keeps its social channels posting and its reviews answered, week after week. The customer approves; SurgeLab runs it.

## The Front Door score
One score out of 100, made of five gates scored 0 to 20 each:
- Found: does AI know you exist?
- Right: is what AI says about you true?
- Clear: can AI answer what's on and what it costs?
- Bookable: can a customer complete the booking?
- Proven: did it turn into money?

## What SurgeLab does
- Free AI audit at https://socialtool.surgelab.co/can-ai-book-you: asks the AI assistants live, scores what they say back. No account or card needed.
- Front Door plan: the score re-checked every week and the lowest gate fixed for the customer, 100 on-brand images a month with captions scheduled to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn, Google Business Profile kept current, reviews answered. Nothing publishes without the customer's approval. SurgeLab measures and fixes; it is not a dashboard.
- Add-ons: video (asset lock keeps logo, products, colours and faces consistent in every frame), AI marketing agents (a roster of 25, each with one job; hire two or more and The Chief of Staff joins free to run them and challenge each one to prove its value). White-label is available to agencies.
- AI consultancy: strategy days, team training and custom agents. Book a call: https://calendly.com/james-surgelab/30min
- Public research: the AI Bookability Index at https://socialtool.surgelab.co/ai-bookability-index.

## Pricing
Front Door: £199 a month, or £2,149 a year (10% off). Prices exclude VAT. Cancel any month. Payment happens inside the tool at the end of the free audit.

## Agencies
Partner pricing scales with the number of brands an agency runs. White-label is available as an add-on. Agencies manage every brand from one dashboard. Enquiries: https://surgelab.co/agencies
